evidence: Modifies peer disconnection logic in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp to change how discouraged peers are disconnected.
rationale: Fixes a network-level DoS vector where an attacker can disconnect honest inbound peers sharing an IP address. As noted in the description, when multiple peers share an IP (such as a Tor exit node), an attacker sending an invalid message currently causes every inbound peer sharing that address to be disconnected.
